pattern.swing: strict fractal, 2 bars on each side, same session, confirmed 2 bars later
pattern.prior_move: the first swing is at least 0.5 ATR(14) beyond the extreme of the prior 12 bars in that session
pattern.separation: 6 to 30 bars between the first and the latest swing
pattern.tolerance: absolute gap at most the larger of 0.15% of the higher swing and 0.5 ATR known when the latest swing confirms
pattern.multi: an earlier swing in that window that matches the latest swing stays in the cluster
pattern.neckline_long: highest high strictly between the first and the latest swing low
pattern.neckline_short: lowest low strictly between the first and the latest swing high
pattern.invalid: a close through the cluster extreme kills the structure

rules.confirmed: long close strictly above the neckline, the 9 EMA, and the 20 EMA; short is the mirror; fill is the next bar's open

filters.vwap: confirmed long and close above session VWAP
filters.ema200: confirmed long and close above the 200 EMA
filters.macd: confirmed long and MACD histogram (12, 26, 9) above zero
filters.short: confirmed double-top mirror, close under the neckline and both EMAs

rules.scalp: long only, same double bottom, before any close above the neckline; a down-close bar after an earlier bar closed above the 9 EMA; the red bar's low holds above the latest swing low and its close holds above the lower of the 9 and 20 EMA; fill is the next open; stop is one cent under that red bar's low
rules.random: seed 17, same count of bars, same direction; stop is one cent beyond that bar; the exit is the cell exit when it does not need a neckline (r1, r2, vwap2); neckline and measured-move targets fall back to 1R because a random bar has no neckline

exits.r1: stop one cent beyond the latest swing, target one R, stop wins a tie
exits.measured: same stop, target is the neckline plus the depth from the cluster extreme
exits.vwap2: same stop, take-profit at the prior bar's session VWAP outer 2 SD band

rules.options: one ATM 0 DTE contract, prior VIX1D else VIX, rate 2 percent, dividend 0
